arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with minimal instrumentation to keep focus on vocals; strong, impactful hooks with layered vocal harmonies and richer instrumentation; cinematic mood maintained throughout via atmospheric FX and chord pads.

event_markers.label: Hook Starts
event_markers.reason: Transition to strong vocal hook section

event_markers.label: Bridge Starts
event_markers.reason: Introduce variation in energy and instrumentation

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation with sparse verses and punchy hooks
track_roles.bass: sub bass complementing drums and vocals for depth
track_roles.vocal: main focus with clear, dynamic delivery
track_roles.fx: environmental and cinematic effects for mood enhancement

sensei_drum.brief: Create dynamic, punchy drum patterns with lower activity during verses and high energy in hook sections, emphasizing trap percussion elements.

bass_generator.brief: Generate sub bass lines that interact gently in verses and intensify with the drums and vocals in hooks, maintaining a clean low-end.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce atmospheric chord pads and harmonic textures supporting the cinematic mood, more prominent in hooks and bridge.

melody_generator.brief: Develop subtle melodic motifs that complement the vocal hook sections without overpowering the vocal lead.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement ensuring vocal focus with sparse verses and strong hooks, balancing cinematic mood and trap elements.

presetor.brief: Apply presets aiding clarity of vocals and cinematic atmosphere without cluttering the sparse arrangement in verses.

songgps.brief: Manage section transitions and maintain energy curve matching the sparse verses and powerful hook dynamics.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix plans focusing on vocal prominence, dynamic contrast between sections, and clean integration of cinematic FX.
